Also EU VAT handling is a concern — we operate in Ireland and may be subject to reverse-charge.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Order form / seats — Sundial deployment (Q3)

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for sending the signed order form. Short answer: we can do either, but we need to align on accounting preference and VAT treatment. Longer answer below and next steps.

What we typically do for mid-cycle seat reductions:
- If the customer requests it before the current invoice is generated, we can issue a negative invoice (credit note) dated within the current billing period and apply it to the outstanding balance.
- If the invoice was already issued, we create a credit note and apply it to the next invoice or issue a refund in exceptional cases (refunds are slower).

Important items for Sundial (EU / reverse-charge):
- If Sundial is VAT-registered in Ireland and provides a valid VAT ID, we will apply reverse-charge on the net movement (credit note reduces taxable supply). Accounting needs the VAT ID and a signed confirmation of place-of-supply.
- Our finance team requires the exact seat change date to compute the pro-rated amount (we pro-rate by seat-days).

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the effective downgrade date (your calendar shows July 1 start-of-day?).
2) Confirm you want a negative invoice issued (credit note) dated within the July cycle vs. applying a credit to August.
3) Share your VAT registration number (VAT IE) and any local contact for finance if you want reverse-charge applied.

I'll loop in Karthik (sales ops) and Sean (billing) to prepare a draft credit note and the accounting treatment. If you prefer, we can apply the credit immediately so the July invoice reflects the reduced charge.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Sundial: mid-cycle downgrade — allocation of negative invoice / credit note

Team — accounting & ops notes below so we can be decisive. Alex, copying the specifics so you have visibility.

Summary of Sundial request: downgrade from 60 -> 40 concurrent seats effective 2026-07-01. Signed order form effective 2026-06-20. Sundial requests a credit in July rather than a carry-forward to August.

Accounting/ops decision tree (recommended):
- Because the effective change date is within the current billing period and the invoice generation for July is still pending for Sundial, we can issue a negative invoice (credit note) dated 2026-07-01 and apply it to the July invoice. That keeps their receivable balance clean.
- VAT: Sundial provided VAT IE: IE3456789X (sample). For reverse-charge, we will zero-rate VAT on the credit note if Sundial supplies a valid VAT and we include reverse-charge wording. Finance needs a one-line confirmation from the customer about their VAT registration and place-of-supply.
- Credit computation: pro-rate by seat-days across July: charge reduction = (20 seats * 31 days pro rata * daily seat rate). Sean, please run the precise calculation and prepare draft credit note.
- If Sundial prefers a refund rather than credit application, we need CFO approval; refunds are slow and carry fees.

Actions:
- Sean to generate draft credit_note PDF and upload to Drive (deadline 2026-07-29 EOD).
- Marissa to confirm with customer that they want the credit applied to July invoice (Alex reply).
- Karthik to confirm reverse-charge language and VAT controls with Finance (reference: EU reverse charge policy doc).

I'll prepare the draft wording for the credit note and the accounting memo.

Thanks,
Karthik
Revenue Operations
